_about: The one place a game term gets its English name. Every keyword, zone, phase, resource, stat, card type and recurring card-text phrase gets an entry BEFORE it appears in code, UI or docs; tools/pirate-ship_cards.py fails on a card field whose term has no entry. For a non-English game 'source' is the printed term; for an English game it is the printed term too (the entry still fixes one spelling and one code). Card names are never translated. tools/pirate-ship_import.py writes files/pirate-ship/GLOSSARY.md from this file.
policy: Card names stay exactly as printed.
Brand words (the game's own coined names) are never translated.
Use the English term in every screen, log line, rule and message; show the original only in the rules help and the glossary.
A new term gets an entry here before it appears anywhere else.
One term, one code: code is the identifier used in JSON fields, enums and CSS classes.

terms.kind: keyword | zone | phase | stat | type | resource | phrase
